dedupe_keys.name: location analysis hybrid abm best location for a new swimming pool in krakow

description: This hybrid agent-based model answers where a new swimming pool should go in a region of Krakow, Poland, and comes with parameters for fitness clubs too. It was built for a PhD thesis on the best location for sport facilities in the Krakow region, which compares agent-based and spatial interaction approaches, and it is described with an ODD protocol at the end of the author's article in JASSS 22(1). Default parameters are set for the swimming pool version, based on the behaviour of swimming pool and fitness club clients. It was published by Lukasz Kowalski on CoMSES in February 2019. Coverage: Krakow, Poland. Access: free Repast code on CoMSES. Licence: GPL-3.0. Caveats: the thesis is in Polish and the model is set up for one city and two kinds of facility. Simulation uses are location planning for public sport and leisure facilities and testing how demand shifts when facilities open or close. Related records: the Statistics Canada recreational and sport facilities database and the MUGS urban green spaces model.
inputs: Existing sport facilities and their attributes
Client behaviour of swimming pools and fitness clubs
name: Location Analysis Hybrid ABM: best location for a new swimming pool in Krakow
